title: Correct a wrong stock number
text: A stock adjustment sets a product to the right quantity and saves the reason. Anyone can see why it changed.
steps: Click sidebar > Inventory, then Stock Adjustment.
Click New Stock Adjustment.
Search the product on the left. Click it to add it.
On the right, type the correct quantity and the reason.
Click Save. Stock changes automatically.

title: Adjustment, loss, or count: which one to use
text: Each one tells a different story in your reports. Choose the option that matches what really happened.
steps: Stock Adjustment: the stock number was wrong, or staff used stock inside the store.
Loss & Damage: items broke, expired, were stolen, or went missing.
Inventory Count: you counted everything on the shelves and recorded the total.
All three of these are under Sidebar > Inventory.

title: Save an adjustment as a draft
text: A draft keeps your rows without changing any stock. Finish it later from the list.
steps: While building the adjustment, click Save as Draft.
To find it later, click Sidebar > Inventory, then Stock Adjustment.
Drafts show a Draft badge in the list.
Click the arrow at the end of the row, then Edit Stock Adjustment.
Finish it and click Save.

title: Adjust many products at once
text: Add All puts every product you can see into the document. Filter first so you only add what you need.
steps: Click Sidebar > Inventory, then Stock Adjustment.
Click New Stock Adjustment.
Filter the left panel by category, shelf, or search.
Click Add All. Every listed product moves to the right.
Type the correct quantities and the reason.
Click Save.

title: Scan items into an adjustment
text: You can scan barcodes straight into the editor. Each scan adds the product and jumps to its row.
steps: Click Sidebar > Inventory, then Stock Adjustment.
Click New Stock Adjustment.
Scan the barcode. The product shows on the right.
Type the correct quantity. Scan the next one.
Add the reason and click Save.

title: Review or delete a past adjustment
text: Each adjustment stays in the list with its reference number and reason.
steps: Open Sidebar > Inventory, then Stock Adjustment.
Search by reference number or reason.
Click the arrow at the end of a row, then View Stock Adjustment.
Select Delete Stock Adjustment to remove it.
Use Print & Export to print or export the list.
